retrievalProfile.description: A cluttered 1980s vanity scene featuring a central framed photograph of a group surrounded by period-specific accessories like pearls, zebra print, and cosmetics.
triggerTerms: retro hip hop album cover aesthetic
cluttered dressing table with zebra print

recipe.visualDefinition: A dense, tactile composition centered on a framed portrait of three men in 80s attire. The frame sits on a lace doily atop a wooden vanity, flanked by nail polish bottles, a black perfume bottle, gold chains, pearls, and a zebra-patterned fabric backdrop. The lighting is warm and slightly diffused, characteristic of mid-80s commercial photography.
coreVisualRelationships: Central framed photograph as the primary focal point
Large-scale bold typography overlapping the top edge
Zebra print fabric providing high-contrast vertical texture in the background
Scattered jewelry and cosmetics creating a busy, lived-in foreground
coreInvariants: Zebra print and lace doily juxtaposition
Central vertical framing of the subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A vertical rectangular photo frame occupies the center 50% of the image height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bold yellow text at the top acts as the primary anchor, balanced by the heavy black perfume bottle on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large top text, drop to the central photo, then spiral outward to the surrounding vanity items.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is intentionally crowded to convey a sense of abundance and personality.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm browns and creams from the wood and lace doily.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black and white from the zebra print and perfume bottle.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant yellow and red in the typography; pops of pink and red in the cosmetics.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the primary colors of the text against a more muted, naturalistic background palette.

characterSpecificRedesigns: U has a deep, rounded bowl
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single dominant display face; secondary text is minimal and functional.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric skeleton and heavy weight.
Provides the necessary impact and 80s commercial feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a still life photo of a 1980s vanity table. In the center, a vertical framed photo of three men in 80s hip hop fashion. Surround the frame with a lace doily, gold chains, pearl necklaces, nail polish bottles, and a black perfume bottle. Background features a zebra-print fabric draped over a mirror. Use warm analog film lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, bold, uppercase sans-serif text across the top. Fill the letters with bright yellow and give them a thick red outline. Ensure the letters are tightly spaced.

verificationChecks: Text is yellow with a red outline
Zebra print is visible in the background
Central photo is framed and vertical

adjustableVariables: Specific pattern of the background fabric
mustRedesign: Do not use flat vector icons
Ensure the central photo does not look like a modern digital print

mustAchieve: Authentic film grain and warm color cast
avoid: Modern sans-serif fonts like Helvetica or Arial

postGenerationChecks: Is the typography the most saturated element?
Does the zebra print provide a strong vertical rhythm?
Is the lace doily texture visible under the objects?
Does the central frame feel like a physical object in the scene?
recipe.reuseFormula: 80s Vanity Still Life = (Central Framed Portrait + Cluttered Jewelry/Cosmetics + Zebra Print Backdrop) * (Bold Yellow/Red Outlined Sans-Serif) + Warm Analog Film Grain
